files.description: The ONC certification page containing the full (b)(10) EHI export attestation statement. This is the registered URL and contains the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation — a ~150-word text statement saying exports are available in PDF and CCDA format via the patient portal or by emailing records@theoriamedical.com. No data dictionary, schema, or format specification exists.
Full-page screenshot of the ONC certification page, showing the certification overview, criteria badges, Real-World Testing links, and the (b)(10) EHI export attestation section.

Screenshot of the ChartEasy Patient Portal login page. Shows the login-walled portal with feature descriptions including 'Download and Transmit your records.' The portal is a Flutter web app (v2.0.8) and requires authentication — no public-facing export documentation is accessible.
